runs.question: What are the four functions of the NIST AI RMF Core?

answer.text:
The AI RMF Core has four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. As illustrated in Figure 5, the Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.

GOVERN is treated differently from the other three. It is meant to run across the whole framework, so it informs the other functions. The MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied to specific AI system contexts and lifecycle stages (While GOVERN applies to all stages of organizations' AI risk management processes and procedures, the MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions can be applied in AI system-specific contexts and at specific stages of the AI lifecycle.).
